summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path (stdlib only). Exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed per instructions. A regex check confirmed no line exceeds 120 columns in the new files. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: missing "image" raises ValueError; missing "label" in segmentation mode is left absent (required by test_seg_no_labels); a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON is reported as a missing key.
